text: 提供商会把对话的开头保留一段时间，让她的下一个请求更便宜。保留一小时的写入费用比五分钟高，如果你说话的间隔比几分钟长，就划算。只保留五分钟的模型会按五分钟请求。

text: 测试通知大约 15 秒后到达。锁定手机即可看到它送达。

en: Shiori's reminders for a time, and the plan's "coming up" and "leave soon", reach you as notifications while annai is closed. Tapping one opens annai, and Shiori catches up.
text: Shiori 的定时提醒，以及行程的“即将开始”和“该出发了”，会在 annai 关闭时以通知送达。轻点一条通知会打开 annai，Shiori 会跟上进度。

en: Reminders go through annai's relay, {0}, unless you run your own: its code is in annai's source, under {1}.
text: 提醒会经过 annai 的中继 {0}，除非你自己运行一个：它的代码在 annai 的源代码中，位于 {1}。

en: annai encrypts every reminder on this phone, and makes each the same size: the relay can't read it, or tell a long one from a short one.
text: annai 会在这部手机上加密每条提醒，并让每条大小相同：中继无法读取，也分不出长短。

text: 它会知道这部手机的推送地址（在负责送达的 Apple、Google 或 Mozilla 那里）、每条提醒的时间，以及有多少条在等待。和任何服务器一样，它能看到手机连接时的网络地址。

en: Reminders about places (arriving, leaving, nearby) never leave the phone. A "leave soon" reminder's time is worked out from where you were when annai last looked, so it tells roughly how far away you were to someone who also knew your plan; the relay doesn't.
text: 关于地点的提醒（到达、离开、附近）从不离开手机。“该出发了”提醒的时间是根据 annai 上次查看时你所在的位置算出的，所以对同样知道你行程的人来说，它能大致看出你当时离得多远；中继看不出来。

en: Each reminder is deleted at the relay once it is sent, or when you cancel it, turn notifications off, or remove its trip.
text: 每条提醒在发送后，或在你取消它、关闭通知、移除其旅行时，会从中继删除。

en: With annai open on screen, annai says a reminder itself, and the relay's copy is called off: you never get it twice.
text: annai 在屏幕上打开时，会自己说出提醒，中继那份会被取消：你永远不会收到两次。

en: The speed goes from 0.5 (slow) to 2 (fast); 1 is normal.
text: 速度从 0.5（慢）到 2（快）；1 为正常。

en: annai hears that you finished a sentence when you pause. A longer pause lets you think mid-sentence; a shorter one answers sooner.
text: 你停顿时，annai 就认为一句话说完了。停顿设长些，你可以在句中思考；设短些，回答更快。

en: Off: what the microphone hears is sent to be written down, then let go. On: each clip is kept with the conversation, and in backups.
text: 关闭：麦克风听到的内容发去转成文字，然后丢弃。开启：每个片段都随对话保存，也包含在备份中。

en: While a live session listens, what you say goes straight to {0} as audio, only while someone speaks, and the chip says "Listening live". It closes after the quiet below, on voice off, or when annai leaves the screen.
text: 实时会话在听时，你说的话会以音频形式直接发给 {0}，只在有人说话时发送，按钮上显示“正在实时收听”。经过下面设定的安静时间、关闭语音，或 annai 离开屏幕时，会话关闭。

en: While a live session listens, what you say goes straight to its provider as audio, only while someone speaks, and the chip says "Listening live". It closes after the quiet below, on voice off, or when annai leaves the screen.
text: 实时会话在听时，你说的话会以音频形式直接发给它的提供商，只在有人说话时发送，按钮上显示“正在实时收听”。经过下面设定的安静时间、关闭语音，或 annai 离开屏幕时，会话关闭。

en: Close after 10 to 300 seconds of quiet.
text: 请设为安静 10 到 300 秒后关闭。

en: Close a live session after (seconds of quiet)
text: 安静多久后关闭实时会话（秒）

en: Only with headphones or car audio: on the phone's own speaker the microphone hears her, so there only a tap cuts her off. Off: only a tap, everywhere, for a car whose speakers echo her voice back.
text: 仅限耳机或车载音响：用手机自身的扬声器时，麦克风会听到她的声音，所以只能轻点打断。关闭：在任何地方都只能轻点，适合扬声器会把她的声音回传的车。

en: What you say goes to the first of these that can hear it; what she says, to the first voice that works. To change the order, go to {0}.
text: 你说的话会发给下面第一个能听的；她说的话，发给第一个能用的声音。要调整顺序，请前往{0}。

en: To keep your voice on the phone, type with your keyboard's microphone key: iPhone and most Android keyboards can dictate on the phone itself.
text: 要让你的声音留在手机上，请用键盘上的麦克风键输入：iPhone 和大多数 Android 键盘都能在手机上听写。

en: annai is a free, open-source travel guide that lives on your phone.
text: annai 是一款住在你手机里的免费开源旅行向导。

en: Its guide is Shiori. She plans the trip with you, keeps your bookings and notes, reminds you at the right time and place, talks with you on the road, and makes a recap afterwards.
text: 它的向导是 Shiori。她和你一起规划旅行，保管你的预订和笔记，在合适的时间和地点提醒你，在路上和你聊天，旅行结束后为你做回顾。

en: She is at the bottom of every screen: tap her to talk, or type.
text: 她在每个屏幕的底部：轻点她来说话，或者打字。

en: annai (案内) is Japanese for "guidance; showing someone around".
text: annai（案内）是日语，意思是“引导；带人四处看看”。

en: Shiori is your guide. She has two halves that work together.
text: Shiori 是你的向导。她有两个协同工作的分身。

note: {0} = KOE; Note: {0} is 声, Koe's name in Japanese; ja needs no gloss.

en: talks with you and answers at once.
note: Note: follows Koe's name in bold: "Koe (声, voice) talks with you…".
{0} = KOKORO; Note: {0} is 心, Kokoro's name in Japanese; ja needs no gloss.

en: thinks things through and does the work: planning, searching, reading your bookings.
text: 仔细思考并完成工作：规划、搜索、读取你的预订。
note: Note: follows Kokoro's name in bold.

en: You only talk to Shiori. While Kokoro works, Koe keeps you company, and tells you when Kokoro has the answer. What they tell each other shows in the conversation; Settings → Shiori can hide it.
text: 你只需要和 Shiori 说话。Kokoro 工作时，Koe 陪着你，并在 Kokoro 有答案时告诉你。它们之间的交流会显示在对话中；可以在设置 → Shiori 中隐藏。

en: Plan the trip day by day with Shiori, and add your confirmations: PDFs, Wallet passes, screenshots. You book; annai never books for you.
text: 和 Shiori 一起按天规划旅行，并添加你的确认信息：PDF、钱包卡券、截图。预订由你来做；annai 从不替你预订。

en: With GPS on, annai follows where you are and reminds you at the right time and place: when to leave, when you've arrived, when you're running late.
text: 开启 GPS 后，annai 会跟随你的位置，在合适的时间和地点提醒你：该出发了、已经到了、快要迟到了。

en: Talk with Shiori hands-free, in the car or on a trail.
text: 在车里或步道上，免提和 Shiori 对话。

en: OpenStreetMap places, Wikipedia summaries and Wikivoyage guides along your plan, for when there's no signal.
text: 沿着行程的 OpenStreetMap 地点、Wikipedia 摘要和 Wikivoyage 指南，供没有信号时使用。

en: Show Shiori what you see, and ask about it.
text: 把你看到的给 Shiori 看，然后问她。

en: Export a file, or back up automatically to GitHub, a Forgejo or Gitea server, an S3 bucket or a WebDAV folder.
text: 导出一个文件，或自动备份到 GitHub、Forgejo 或 Gitea 服务器、S3 存储桶或 WebDAV 文件夹。
插件和 MCP 服务器。

en: Skills, tools and screens that others make.
text: 别人制作的技能、工具和界面。

en: Afterwards, a recap of the trip, and its route played back.
text: 旅行结束后，有旅行回顾，还能回放路线。

en: annai is built so your keys and data stay yours. Here is exactly how, and where that stops.
text: annai 的设计让你的密钥和数据始终归你所有。下面详细说明怎么做到的，以及它的边界在哪里。

en: Shiori can search the web as soon as you start, through free services. No key, nothing to set up.
text: 从一开始，Shiori 就能通过免费服务搜索网络。不需要密钥，也不用设置。

en: You can also install annai as an app from your browser's menu.
text: 你也可以从浏览器菜单把 annai 安装为应用。

en: Safari can erase what annai keeps after 7 days without a visit, and the Home Screen app keeps data of its own. Add annai to your Home Screen, and set up your model there.
text: Safari 浏览器可能会在 7 天没有访问后清除 annai 保存的内容，而主屏幕上的 App 有自己的数据。请把 annai 添加到主屏幕，并在那里设置你的模型。

en: Your browser may clear what annai keeps when space runs low. Install annai to keep your trips safe.
text: 空间不足时，浏览器可能会清除 annai 保存的内容。安装 annai，保护好你的旅行。

text: 然后，在主屏幕上的 App 中

en: Free search sends your searches to Exa, Parallel or Firecrawl: just the words searched, not your files or your location. Exa also reads a page that no other reader can, which sends it that page's address. They are free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use what is searched to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of your searches. Behind them, a last resort that is always on asks Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) the same words; only Search via: Off stops it.
text: 免费搜索会把你的搜索发送给 Exa、Parallel 或 Firecrawl：只发送搜索的词，不发送你的文件或位置。Exa 还会读取其他方式读不了的网页，因此也会收到该网页的地址。它们都是可能变化或停止的免费额度，而且 Exa 和 Parallel 可能用搜索内容训练模型，所以请不要在搜索中写名字和地址。在它们之后，还有一个始终开启的最后手段，会用同样的词询问 Wikimedia（Wikivoyage 和 Wikipedia）和 OpenStreetMap（Nominatim）；只有“搜索方式：关闭”能停止它。
note: Note: "Search via: Off" as the choice is named on this screen.

en: Only the words she searches for go to the ones you leave ticked, and Exa also gets the addresses of pages it reads for her: not your files or your location. They're free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use searches to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of them. Behind them, Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) are always asked as a last resort; only Settings → Tools → Search via: Off stops that. You can change all this there.
text: 只有她搜索的词会发送给你保留勾选的服务，Exa 还会收到它为她读取的网页地址：不发送你的文件或位置。它们都是可能变化或停止的免费额度，而且 Exa 和 Parallel 可能用搜索训练模型，所以请不要在搜索中写名字和地址。在它们之后，作为最后手段，始终会询问 Wikimedia（Wikivoyage 和 Wikipedia）和 OpenStreetMap（Nominatim）；只有设置 → 工具 → 搜索方式：关闭能停止它。这些都可以在那里更改。
